title: Rank-two intervention designs can still be nearly unidentifiable under cross-talk

interpretation.0: collinear intervention directions; no branch separation
interpretation.1: orthogonal intervention directions; maximal geometric separation in the 2-branch model

known_answers.result: formally identifiable but poorly separated; tiny perturbations/noise can dominate coefficient recovery

HF01_implication: Do not treat rank=2 alone as a strong biological identifiability claim.
Estimate actual intervention directions from proximal branch readouts whenever possible.
AR-path probes and mechanical-path probes should include non-target readouts so cross-talk is observable rather than assumed absent.
A nominally selective drug or knockdown is not automatically a selective system-identification input.

source_bound_next_measurements.A_AR_proximal: an AR-dependent proximal readout chosen before analysis; exact marker panel remains to be frozen from source evidence
source_bound_next_measurements.M_proximal: CTS contraction/p-MLC2/AFM or directly validated mechanical proxy
source_bound_next_measurements.functional: hair-follicle elongation, cycle state, progenitor survival/proliferation

claim_boundary: This score measures design geometry only. It is not a probability of biological truth or treatment success.
